content: latexmk latest 4.88 (2026-03-09); local 4.87 via MiKTeX, runs from Python subprocess using Git perl or Strawberry perl on PATH. Verified: latexmk -lualatex -lualatex='lualatex --disable-installer %O %S' -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -file-line-error compiles a tcolorbox raster + tabularx + fontspec(Arial) + babel ngerman card sheet in ~30s.
